2. If the program is absent or its answer is rejected, request only the demonstrations needed to infer the rule. Implement or fix `transform(grid)` and run it against every exact pair received; require exact input-output matches before submitting. When transcribing grids for local testing, assert row count and every row width against the stated dimensions; fix transcription errors before trusting results.
3. Run the verified transform on the test input and copy its returned grid exactly into the required submit action; do not manually adjust cells. Keep the required action JSON as the final line.
4. After verdict, save the transform that reproduces all received pairs at `programs/<task id>.py`, replacing the old version, then finish only when the instance is over.
